svg.title: Q9: a suitable y can be chosen for every real x
svg.desc: Original equation-driven curves with explicit domains,axis windows and independently checked sample values; no joins across excluded inputs.
svg.text: Q9: a suitable y can be chosen for every real x
The chosen line is always above it.
Its formal negation is therefore false.
Read the stated domain and axis scales. Exact root counts,bounds and identities are proved in the text.
